commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Rename chatbot to Johnny and add greeting/farewell message
commitResults.messageBody:
Rename Duke class to Johnny and update all references in README files.
  Add startup banner, greeting, and farewell output on exit.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add echo loop and exit on 'bye' command
commitResults.messageBody:
Read user input in a loop, echo each command back, and exit
  gracefully when the user types 'bye'.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add task list storage and retrieval
commitResults.messageBody:
Store user input in a fixed-size array and display all stored
  items with numbered indices when the user types 'list'.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add mark task as done functionality
commitResults.messageBody:
Add 'mark <number>' command to mark tasks as completed.
  Display done status as [X]/[ ] in the task list with a
  'Here are the tasks in your list:' header.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add unmark command to reverse task done status
commitResults.messageBody:
Add 'unmark <number>' command that sets a task back to not done
  and displays confirmation with the [ ] status indicator.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Extract Task class into separate file
commitResults.messageBody:
Move task description and done status into a Task class with
  markAsDone(), markAsNotDone(), and toString() methods.
  Replace parallel String[] and boolean[] arrays with a Task[] array.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Add present-changes-visually skill for Claude Code
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a project-specific Claude Code skill that generates GitHub-style
  split-view HTML diffs of repository changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add test-ui skill and UI test plan
commitResults.messageBody:
Create a Claude Code skill that runs scripted UI tests against the
  CLI app and verifies output. Add 4 initial test cases covering
  greet/exit, add/list, mark, and unmark. Update AGENTS.md to require
  test plan updates and test runs after every code change.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add todo, deadline, and event task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Support 'todo', 'deadline /by', and 'event /from /to' commands.
  Display task type prefix [T]/[D]/[E] in list and mark/unmark output.
  Dates/times are stored as plain strings for now.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Use inheritance for Todo, Deadline, and Event task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract Todo, Deadline, and Event as subclasses of Task.
  Each overrides toString() to add its type prefix and fields.
  Store all tasks polymorphically in a Task[] array.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add error handling with custom JohnnyException
commitResults.messageBody:
Handle empty todo descriptions and unrecognized commands by
  throwing JohnnyException with user-friendly error messages.
  Unrecognized input now shows an error instead of being added as a task.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add delete command and switch to ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace fixed-size Task[] array with ArrayList<Task> for dynamic sizing.
  Add 'delete <number>' command that removes a task and reports
  the updated task count.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Use Command enum and switch statement for input handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace chained if/else-if with a Command enum and switch statement.
  Split user input into command word and arguments, convert to enum
  via valueOf(), and dispatch with switch for cleaner control flow.
